name: Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of mobile communication equipment and application products in China and internationally. It offers products, such as network communication, data communication, mobile communication, automobile electronics, and AI intelligence; intelligent manufacturing, including circular automatic plate measuring machine, automatic locking screw machine, automatic labeling machine, packing barcode comparison machine, screen printing automatic inspection machine, and automatic box sealing and stacking machine; and provides sales services. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
